item.title: htmx 4.0: a Fetch-Based Rewrite, Built-In Morphing Swaps, and Explicit Attribute Inheritance
item.description: htmx 4 has been released, featuring a transition from XMLHttpRequest to the fetch() API, enhancing streaming capabilities. Key updates include built-in morphing swaps for DOM state preservation and an hx-partial tag for cleaner updates. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Neat Annotations: Elegant Hand-Drawn Annotations with CSS
item.description: Arrows and handwritten labels for your website. Pure CSS, no JavaScript. (2 sources: frontendfocus, rubyweekly)

item.title: What is still exciting in tech?
item.description: A comment on a lobste.rs post about the tech culture stagnating made me think. 20-15 or even 10 years ago, tech was really exciting. Sure, monopolies were bad, I was fighting them, but tech by itself was very interesting. (1 source: lobsters)
